products.name: Palantir AIP
products.note: Enterprise AI platform; Ontology-based governance; defense/intel focus; high-stakes decision influence

profile_text.body:
Palantir is a publicly traded software company (NASDAQ: PLTR, CIK 0001321655) that, according to its own website, builds software intended to help organizations integrate their data, decisions, and operations. The company describes its offering with the tagline "Foundational Software of Tomorrow. Delivered Today."

Palantir's principal AI product tracked on this site is Palantir AIP, categorized as a Data and Analytics AI platform. It is characterized by an Ontology-based governance approach and a focus on defense, intelligence, and other high-stakes decision-making environments. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings beyond the CIK record, or patent facts are currently held for this entry.
